text:
Date: The outage began at 02:14 on 17 April, after the primary cooling pump in Hall C stopped working.

Named person: Tomasz Velkarin, facilities operations lead at the Ruvenna data centre, confirmed the pump failure to staff the same morning.

Figure: Temperatures in Hall C rose from 22°C to 38°C in 41 minutes, forcing an automatic shutdown of 312 server racks.

Source document: The report rests on Incident Review IR-2217, issued by the Ruvenna Infrastructure Authority on 9 May.
